description.la: De diversis quaestionibus octoginta tribus. Textus Latinus secundum editionem Maurinorum.
description.en-US: Eighty-Three Different Questions (388-396), by St. Augustine of Hippo. Latin text of the Maurist edition; no public-domain English translation has been imported yet.
description.pt-BR: Oitenta e três questões diversas (388-396), de Santo Agostinho de Hipona. Texto latino da edição dos Maurinos.

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages ottantatre_questioni of augustinus.it, one page per book, long pages split at chapter boundaries. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.
